name: Confirm dialog
summary: A destructive confirmation shown open: what will be deleted, what happens next, and a typed workspace name that unlocks the red Delete button. Placement and the backdrop are the project's.
use: before an action that cannot be undone, such as deleting data
a11y: An alertdialog labelled by its title and described by its sentence; the input has a visible label and hint, Delete stays a disabled native button until the typed name matches, and Enter confirms once it does.

use_when: deleting several records at once, where listing them lets the person check what goes before they type to confirm
avoid_when: a reversible action: act at once and offer Undo in toast-stack
an approval decision with money and policy context: use approval-panel
editing or reading a record beside a list: use detail-drawer

parts.name: mark
parts.what: a warning icon in a red circle

parts.name: title
parts.what: the question, naming what will be deleted

parts.name: lede
parts.what: what happens next and that it cannot be undone

parts.name: items
parts.what: one thing to be deleted: name, a small date, and an amount

parts.name: confirm_label
parts.what: the instruction, with the exact text to type in code

parts.name: confirm_input
parts.what: where the person types the name

parts.name: delete
parts.what: the red action, unlocked by a matching name

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if deleting fails, keep the dialog open, re-enable the buttons and add an alert-banners line above the footer

disabled.how: Delete stays disabled, pale red with a not-allowed cursor, until the typed text matches; the sample is pre-typed, so it opens enabled

overflow.how: in a narrow box the buttons stack full width with Delete on top; the item list has no height limit, so keep it to a few lines

long_text.how: a long item name ends in an ellipsis and the amount never wraps; a long name to type breaks anywhere

keyboard: Tab reaches the text box, then Cancel, then Delete when it is enabled
Enter in the text box presses Delete once the typed text matches
Enter or Space presses the focused button
the file has no Escape handling or focus trap; the project's dialog code must add them
